mostWorthwhile.text: Making ATP from glucose was most worthwhile because the picture connected food and oxygen to usable cell energy.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing mitochondria felt less satisfying on its own because it showed where they go but not yet what they do.

surprise.text: I was surprised that ATP helped build the protein without becoming part of it; the amino acids formed the chain instead.

arbitrary.text: Using ATP with the ribosome initially felt like following the only compatibility hint: its role in protein building had not yet been explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because connecting the glucose route to ATP and then protein building made me curious how cell parts support larger structures.
